Title: Nvidia crushed earnings but one analyst is rating it a "sell"
description: Nvidia (NVDA) delivered a strong quarter, beating Wall Street expectations and offering a stronger-than-expected outlook. But with the AI trade already priced for near-perfection, even another blowout may not be enough to move investors.  Seaport Research Partners senior analyst Jay Goldberg joins Josh Lipton on Asking for a Trend to explain why Nvidia’s impressive results could ultimately be a “nobody is going to care” moment for the stock.
